what_happened: Mathlib's SimpleGraph/Acyclic.lean (v4.33 pin) turned out to carry exactly the API the oriented-forest argument needs (IsAcyclic.subsingleton_path, eq_penultimate_of_adj_end, path_concat), so a 200-line compiling prototype verified steps 1-3 of report 03 section 1.2's five-step argument plus merge existence inside the research dispatch rather than deferring all risk to implementation.

Located the single residual hard step: the step-4 independence claim (the merge vertex does not depend on the chosen member) is NOT derivable from directed-path uniqueness. Exhibited the 4-node digraph a->c, b->c, a->y, b->y as a witness: it has unique directed paths between any two nodes and two distinct divergent meets. The step therefore requires genuinely undirected-cycle reasoning via Mathlib path uniqueness, confirming task 884's amendment consumption map empirically rather than by recall.
